description: The Flora-Bama Yacht Club is a legendary restaurant in Orange Beach. You can come by boat, car, paddleboard, float... as long as you get here. We are known for our original menu items and local seafood. There is something for almost everyone. Our award winning Chefs and the friendly staff make every dining experience fun. We have large outdoor deck and beach area. Relax on our sand and listen to the fantastic music from local and visiting musicians. Nothing like a dinner and Bushwacker at the FBYC.
atmosphere: Open air and waterfront views with outdoor deck and beach area
